aboutGame.title: What is Terrible Lizards?
paragraphs: Terrible Lizards is a first-person horror parkour game developed by WDR Studios in collaboration with JT Music. Players are dropped into the overgrown ruins of Dalton's Dinos, an abandoned Route 66 roadside attraction, where genetically revived dinosaurs hunt anything that moves.

Survival depends on momentum rather than firepower: slide down slopes, vault low obstacles, kick off walls, and climb to higher ground while watching your stamina and the noise you make. This wiki collects beginner routes, parkour tech, creature threat tiers, boss strategies, story lore, and release details in one place.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Terrible Lizards.

items.question: What is Terrible Lizards?
items.answer: Terrible Lizards is a first-person horror parkour game from WDR Studios and JT Music. Players flee genetically revived dinosaurs through the ruins of Dalton's Dinos, an abandoned Route 66 roadside attraction.

items.question: Is Terrible Lizards a horror game or a dinosaur survival sim?
items.answer: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game first. You survive by running, climbing, and breaking line of sight rather than managing hunger or building bases, so momentum and stealth matter more than survival-sim systems.

items.question: Can you fight the dinosaurs in Terrible Lizards?
items.answer: Direct combat is a costly last resort in Terrible Lizards. Most encounters are won by breaking line of sight, climbing to higher ground, and using the environment instead of standing your ground.

items.question: Where does Terrible Lizards take place?
items.answer: Terrible Lizards is set in Dalton's Dinos, a decaying dinosaur-themed roadside attraction on Route 66. Neon signs, motel scaffolding, and rusted billboards double as parkour routes and hiding spots.

items.question: Is there a free demo of Terrible Lizards?
items.answer: Yes. A free demo for Terrible Lizards is available on Steam, letting you test the opening chase, movement tech, and creature behavior before the full release.

items.question: What platforms is Terrible Lizards on?
items.answer: Terrible Lizards debuts on PC through Steam, with PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S ports planned after the PC early access phase stabilizes.
